search_window.basis: Authenticated readback of prior 05:44-scheduled watch heartbeat; expanded beyond nominal hour only to capture latest publications, with Arabic first-edition timestamp before prior cutoff and English edition after it.

findings.title: Gaza hospitals receive three fatalities and seven injured people over 24 hours; updated cumulative death/injury totals
findings.publisher: WAFA Palestinian News and Information Agency citing medical sources in Gaza
findings.affected_population_system: Palestinian civilian casualties, Gaza hospitals, and ambulance/rescue access; three bodies, including one person who died of prior wounds, and seven injured people received over the preceding 24 hours. Cumulative reported conflict toll 74,702 killed and 176,105 injured since October 2023; since October 2025 ceasefire 1,650 fatalities and 5,975 injuries.
findings.finding_summary: WAFA posted a new 16 November health-source casualty update: three fatalities (one died of earlier injuries) and seven injured patients received by Gaza hospitals in the prior 24 hours; updated ceasefire cumulative totals are 1,650 fatalities and 5,975 injuries. Arabic report at 16:06 Jerusalem (06:06 PST), slightly before preceding heartbeat cutoff, but unrecorded there; English edition posted 16:24 Jerusalem (06:24 PST), after the cutoff. This is a late-recalled daily casualty update, not evidence of three distinct newly occurring attacks, and not to be added on top of previously recorded individual Jabalia, Beit Lahia and Khan Younis cases.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: وقالت مصادر طبية، إن مستشفيات قطاع غزة استقبلت، خلال الساعات الأربع والعشرين الماضية، 3 شهداء بينهم شهيد متأثرا بجروحه، و7 إصابات.

bounded_discovery_context.new_information: New 24-hour reported hospital intake of three dead and seven injured, with updated Gaza cumulative conflict and post-ceasefire totals; not necessarily distinct from existing incident-level records.
bounded_discovery_context.dating_caveat: The body dateline in WAFA Arabic/English says 15 October 2026, inconsistent with 16 November article URL, website index, 16 Nov publication timestamp and contemporary figures. Publication date uses site's actual 16 November listing; exact 24h reporting-window cutoff not stated.
bounded_discovery_context.verification: Arabic and English WAFA pages give matching body/intake and cumulative figures. Al Jazeera's Nov 16 reporting shows 1,647 deaths/5,969 injuries as of prior day, without validating specific intake figures independently.
bounded_discovery_context.double_counting_warning: Do not add these aggregate hospital arrivals to incident-level deaths/injuries or assume all happened after prior hourly cutoff.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only, not a primary production daily collector or publisher.
